These controls don't repair the library. Privileged containers, device mounts, or custom partition or filesystem tooling require reassessment.

Debian lists the exact Bookworm GnuTLS 3.7.9-2+deb12u7 package as vulnerable and has no fixed Bookworm package on 2026-10-11. A subjectAltName that holds only an SRV otherName with an OCTET STRING value doesn't suppress the Common Name fallback, so a trusted certificate can name any host in its Common Name. In the API image, GnuTLS loads through libcurl3-gnutls, libldap, librtmp, and apt. Python, httpx, and libpq use OpenSSL. The supplied API reaches GnuTLS only when Git fetches a mirror over HTTPS. MirrorPolicy limits webhook clone URLs to http, https, git, and ssh, and to the operator's clone-host allowlist when one is set. Git runs with default settings and GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL, so it makes no LDAP or RTMP request. SSH remotes don't use GnuTLS. Exploitation needs a network position on the path to an allowed forge and such a certificate from an authority in the image trust store. The CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements forbid otherName entries in publicly trusted server certificates, so this needs a misissuing or compromised authority. These conditions reduce exposure; they don't patch GnuTLS. An impostor that passes verification can receive HTTPS Git credentials and withhold or alter fetched refs. Reassess custom CA bundles, proxies, LDAP service lookups, Git configuration in reused mirror volumes, and any added HTTPS caller. Apply a distribution fix rather than extending this mitigation.

Debian lists the exact Bookworm GnuTLS 3.7.9-2+deb12u7 package as vulnerable and has no fixed Bookworm package on 2026-10-11. A subjectAltName that holds only an SRV otherName with an OCTET STRING value doesn't suppress the Common Name fallback, so a trusted certificate can name any host in its Common Name. In the PostgreSQL image, GnuTLS loads through libldap, dirmngr, and apt. PostgreSQL's own TLS uses OpenSSL. The supplied pg_hba configuration accepts only SCRAM-SHA-256, so the server makes no LDAP connection, and the deployment runs neither dirmngr nor apt. These conditions reduce exposure; they don't patch GnuTLS. LDAP authentication, an LDAP service lookup, an extension that opens TLS through GnuTLS, or arbitrary commands invalidate this assessment. Apply a distribution fix rather than extending this mitigation.

Git's three-way merge (xdiff) heap overflow remains in the installed git packages. The API mirror substrate invokes only init --bare, config, fetch, cat-file, rev-list, diff-tree, merge-base, and related read-only plumbing; it never runs git merge or other three-way merge entry points. Debian has no fixed Bookworm package. Process and deployment confinement and the measured default Git configuration limit impact; a custom caller that invokes git merge on attacker-controlled trees invalidates this assessment. This is not a library fix.

Git's recursive-clone submodule metadata flaw remains in the installed git packages. The API mirror creates a bare repository and refreshes it with git fetch; it never runs git clone --recurse-submodules or otherwise materializes submodule checkouts. Debian has no fixed Bookworm package. Process and deployment confinement and the measured default Git configuration limit impact; enabling recursive submodule clones invalidates this assessment. This is not a library fix.

Process and deployment confinement limit impact; enabling Kerberos authentication or installing KDC/kadmind packages invalidates this assessment. This is not a library fix.
